description: Finish a chunked upload: the server assembles the chunks, validates the image, and hosts it on the Schedulala CDN, returning the url + media id for create_post. Call once every chunk has been sent via append_generated_media_chunk. ONLY for files YOU generated in this conversation (charts, cards, edited images). NEVER for user-attached files or files on the user's device - those go through attach_media (the in-chat upload widget, full quality). Never send more than 8000 base64 characters in one call - larger payloads are silently truncated by the chat channel.
name: finish_generated_media_upload
title: Finish Generated Media Upload
